mapper.select: SELECT CAST(stat_date AS CHAR) AS statDate, SUM(total_energy) AS totalEnergy, SUM(energy_cost) AS totalCost FROM energy_stat WHERE stat_type = #{statType} AND stat_date BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE) GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT d.device_name AS deviceName, SUM(e.total_energy) AS totalEnergy, SUM(e.energy_cost) AS totalCost FROM energy_stat e JOIN device d ON e.device_id = d.id WHERE e.stat_type = 'DAILY' AND e.stat_date BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE) GROUP BY e.device_id, d.device_name ORDER BY totalEnergy DESC

SELECT CAST(stat_date AS CHAR) AS statDate, SUM(total_energy) AS totalEnergy, SUM(energy_cost) AS totalCost FROM energy_stat WHERE stat_type = #{statType} AND stat_date BETWEEN CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE) GROUP BY stat_date ORDER BY stat_date

SELECT DATE(end_time) AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(total_energy), 0) AS totalEnergy, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM usage_record WHERE end_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND end_time < DATE_ADD(CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE(end_time) ORDER BY statDate

SELECT d.device_name AS deviceName, COALESCE(SUM(u.total_energy), 0) AS totalEnergy, COALESCE(SUM(u.total_cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM usage_record u JOIN device d ON d.id = u.device_id WHERE u.end_time >= CAST(#{startDate} AS DATE) AND u.end_time < DATE_ADD(CAST(#{endDate} AS DATE), INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY u.device_id, d.device_name ORDER BY totalEnergy DESC
SELECT CAST(CURDATE() AS CHAR) AS statDate, COALESCE(SUM(total_energy), 0) AS totalEnergy, COALESCE(SUM(total_cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM usage_record WHERE end_time >= CURDATE()

SELECT d.device_name AS deviceName, COALESCE(SUM(u.total_energy), 0) AS totalEnergy, COALESCE(SUM(u.total_cost), 0) AS totalCost FROM usage_record u JOIN device d ON d.id = u.device_id WHERE u.end_time >= CURDATE() GROUP BY u.device_id, d.device_name ORDER BY totalEnergy DESC
